visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a woman in a pink knitted sweater and a thick red scarf riding a white and pink motorcycle slowly towards the camera. The setting is a sun-drenched park with green grass and tall trees in the background. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the front wheel and the side fairing of the bike, which features bold black and pink geometric graphic patterns. (3) The camera shifts to a medium shot of the woman gripping the handlebars; she wears gold circular earrings and has short dark hair with a fringe. She looks directly into the lens and smiles warmly. (4) Standing behind the parked motorcycle, she begins energetic hand gestures, pointing to the sky, clapping her hands, and then bringing her palms together in a prayer-like greeting. (5) Bright yellow variety text overlays appear on the screen as she continues to move her arms expressively against the backdrop of the park. (6) The scene cuts to a black screen filled with shimmering golden light particles, displaying the year 2025 and new year greetings in both Chinese and English characters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the loud, mechanical rumble of a motorcycle engine idling and revving, accompanied by the faint rustling of outdoor wind. A high-tempo electronic beat with a synthesized melody fades in quickly. (2) A sharp transition occurs as a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice enters, greetings viewers with a bright tone. The motorcycle engine noise drops into the background as the vocal takes center stage. (3) A series of quick 'pop' or 'bubble' sound effects are perfectly synchronized with the rhythm of the speaker's energetic delivery. The background music maintains a constant, upbeat 4/4 electronic rhythm. (4) The speaker's voice rises in pitch and arousal during a sequence of festive greetings, punctuated by a metallic 'ding' SFX. The audio concludes with a high-energy celebratory shout followed by a shimmering magic wand sparkle effect as the music swells and then hard-cuts to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a vibrant and energetic Chinese New Year greeting for the Year of the Snake 2025. By combining a stylish 'cool girl' persona riding a motorcycle with upbeat music and festive wordplay, the creator aims to share positive energy and auspicious wishes with her audience.
